Container.Name: Calvin
Container.Overview: Calvin is a self-hosted dashboard for calendars, photos, web services, and plugins. On Unraid, run this container as the backend and point one or more Raspberry Pi kiosk displays at the WebUI URL. Tracks the develop branch: every push to develop publishes a new :develop image; use Check for Updates in the Docker tab to pull it. The container never controls the Unraid host: reboot, backend/frontend restarts, update and display commands are disabled (CALVIN_HOST_CONTROL does not override this) — update and restart from the Docker tab instead.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Calvin web UI and API.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Calvin data: SQLite database, images, and installed plugins.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Address phones and new kiosks use to reach Calvin, e.g. http://192.0.2.10:8000 (your Unraid server's LAN IP and the WebUI port). Shown as a QR code in Settings and in the Add kiosk install command; the container cannot detect it itself.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Optional. Sets (or resets) Calvin's admin password on startup, so the first Settings visit does not claim it. At least 8 characters; leave empty to choose it in Settings.

Config.Name: Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated host names Calvin accepts besides LAN IPs, mDNS (.local) and single-label names, e.g. calvin.example.com. Use * to turn the Host check off. Needed when you reach Calvin through a domain name or a proxy that does not preserve the Host header.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the files in Appdata. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the files in Appdata. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Database URL used by Calvin. The default stores SQLite inside Appdata.

Config.Name: Image Directory
Config.Description: Container path where Calvin stores and reads image files.

Config.Name: Plugin Directory
Config.Description: Container path where Calvin stores installed plugins.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Allowed CORS origins. Usually not needed for kiosk use because Calvin serves the frontend and API from the same origin.
